head: 4perf is a camera app with Night Boost for low light
dek: 4perf has automatic exposure that adjusts from day to night, manual controls a gesture away, and Night Boost, which stacks a burst into one clean low-light photo. It was #28 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 5 November.
details: It came out on 4 November and costs $4.99, by Sid Singh.
means: If your night photos come out noisy, it's built for that.
